messages:
marta (Billing): Heads-up — Violet Labs invoice INV-2026-0913 is past due (USD 4,250). Multiple CC attempts failed (last 4: 4242). Customer replied to support saying they had a billing system migration and asked for help. Proposing a provisional credit so product isn't cut off + staged authorization plan. Thoughts?
ajay (FinOps): Can you paste the decline reason from the gateway? need to confirm it's a card issue vs bank block. Also -> do we have permission to apply provisional credits without exec ok?
sam (Collections): If it's a short-term issue we usually offer either 1) single retry after 7 days + dunning pause, or 2) split into 3 payments (50% now, 25% 30d, 25% 60d). For $4.2k option 2 seems fine. Include signed payment agreement.
marta (Billing): Gateway note: "card_declined_insufficient_funds" then rcode 05 on last retry. Customer asked explicitly to waive late fee and avoid suspend for now. They said they'll get new card by EOD tomorrow.
lina (Billing Manager): I can approve waiving up to $75 in late fees without further sign-off, but anything above needs AP/Finance ok. For provisional credit: what's proposed amount? We rarely do full credit unless legal signs off.
ajay (FinOps): Suggest provisional credit = $150 (covers current late fees + buffer) and require new CC on file + signed staged-agreement. If new card posts within 72h, we claw back provisional credit. Also, tag GL: 4201-BILLED-REC in case we need reversing entry.
marta (Billing): Okay — propose: provisional credit $150, staged plan: charge $2,125 (50%) when new card is added, then $1,062.50 at 30d and 60d. Customer must sign agreement and add card by tomorrow. I'll attach dunning pause so product stays live.
sam (Collections): Works for me. I'll draft the staged payment agreement and ping legal for a quick look. Also recommend we set up auto-retry schedule: 24h/72h after card update.
billing-bot: System note: invoice INV-2026-0913 status set to "collections_pending" by marta (Billing) at 2159998800.
lina (Billing Manager): I approve provisional credit up to $150 contingent on signed agreement + card on file. Please capture an audit note in the invoice and route to AP for GL tagging.
ajay (FinOps): I'll approve the GL code and reversal flow. Once signed, finance will run the reversal if the provisional credit needs clawing back.
marta (Billing): I'll send the agreement now and post the payment link. Sam — can you hold the template and loop in legal?
sam (Collections): Yep, drafting now. will drop template in this thread when done.
marta (Billing): Final plan posted to customer; they confirmed they'll add card tomorrow. Marking follow-up for 72h out. Who will mark invoice when payments clear?
lina (Billing Manager): Marta — you can mark as reconciled once first payment hits. I'll handle GL posting. If customer misses the 72h window, escalate back to Collections.
ajay (FinOps): Sounds good. Note: please include this in weekly AR summary so leadership sees the concession (provisional credit $150).
marta (Billing): Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
